sources.title: [2505.19115] FP4 All the Way: Fully Quantized Training of LLMs
sources.snippet: We demonstrate, for the first time, fully quantized training (FQT) of large language models (LLMs) using predominantly 4-bit floating-point (FP4) precision for weights, activations, and gradients on datasets up to 200 billion tokens.
